### Fold-Change Analysis

```{r, warning=F, message=F, echo=F}
df = data.frame()
 if (n.groups == 1) {
      df = data.frame(message = "Less than 2 groups selected. No Fold-Change Analysis to perform.")
    } else if (n.groups > 1) {
      
      grupos = unique(exp.tab$group)
      cont = 0
      for (i in 1:(length(grupos)-1)){
        for (j in (i+1):length(grupos)){
          meanA = mean(filter(exp.tab, group == grupos[i])$twoDeltaCq, na.rm = T)
          meanB = mean(filter(exp.tab, group == grupos[j])$twoDeltaCq, na.rm = T)
          cont=cont+1
          df[cont,1:2] = c(meanA/meanB, meanB/meanA)
          row.names(df)[cont] = paste(grupos[i], grupos[j], sep="-")
        }
      }
      colnames(df) = c("FC", "1/FC")
    }

kable(df, digits = 2) %>% kable_styling()

```

### Normality test

```{r, warning=F, message=F, echo=F}

df = as.data.frame(exp.tab %>% group_by(group) %>% summarise(count=n()))
      df$shapiro.p.value = 0
      for (i in 1:nrow(df)){
        a = filter(exp.tab, group == df$group[i])
        df$shapiro.p.value[i] = shapiro.test(a$deltaCq)$p.value
      }
kable(df, digits = 4) %>% kable_styling()

```

### Differential Expression Analysis Results

```{r, warning=F, message=F, echo=F}
if (n.groups == 1) {
      print("Less than 2 groups selected. No Differential Expression Analysis to perform.")
    } else if (n.groups == 2) {
      t.test(formula = deltaCq ~ group, data = exp.tab)
    } else if (n.groups > 2) {
      model = aov(formula = deltaCq ~ group, data = exp.tab)
      print("ANOVA Results:")
      print(summary(model))
      print(TukeyHSD(model))
    }
if (n.groups == 1) {
      print("Less than 2 groups selected. No Differential Expression Analysis to perform.")
    } else if (n.groups == 2) {
      wilcox.test (formula = deltaCq ~ group, data = exp.tab)
    } else if (n.groups > 2) {
      dunn.test(x = exp.tab$deltaCq, g = exp.tab$group, kw = T, method = "BH")
    }
```
